dues.admin.ledger.appendOnly: Append-only, written as money moves: charges positive, refunds and chargebacks negative. Stripe’s dashboard is the authority; this is the board’s own copy in {currency}.
dues.admin.members.cancelled: Renewal cancelled. They keep what they paid for until the period ends.
dues.admin.members.description: Every membership this plugin has sold, flagged rows first. Extending is a grant, not a charge; revoking removes access on the spot without touching the money — refunds happen in Stripe’s dashboard, and the refund webhook revokes on its own.
dues.admin.members.extended: Membership extended. The member holds their group until the new date.
dues.admin.members.grantRefused: The extension was recorded, but the board refused the group grant — the row is flagged with the reason.
dues.admin.members.noMembership: That membership is not live any more, so there is nothing to act on.
dues.admin.members.noRenewal: Only a live subscription has a renewal to cancel.
dues.admin.members.revoked: Membership revoked. Their access is gone as of now.
dues.admin.members.stripeError: Stripe could not be reached. Nothing changed — try again shortly.
dues.admin.members.stripeUnconfigured: Stripe is not configured, so the subscription cannot be reached.
dues.admin.status.attention: {count, plural, one {# record needs attention} other {# records need attention}} — a payment that could not become a membership, or an amount that did not match its order. The members screen lists {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} first.
dues.admin.status.flagMissing: That flag could not be found — it may already be cleared.
dues.admin.status.keyUnset: not set — nothing can be bought
dues.admin.status.none: None yet. The first purchase, or Stripe’s “send test event” button, will put a row here — which is how you prove the endpoint works.
dues.admin.status.ordersText: Money moved but the order could not settle cleanly — most often an amount that did not match. Check the payment in Stripe’s dashboard, put it right there, then clear the flag here.
dues.admin.status.plansText: Plans are made and changed on the plans screen. Each grants membership of its group only while that group is marked “may be granted by plugins” under Admin → Groups; a purchase against a group that refuses shows up above as needing attention, with the payment kept and the reason recorded.
dues.admin.status.source: Keys resolve environment-first: the settings form below this page shows which source is winning.
dues.admin.status.unprocessed: unprocessed — the reconcile task retries it
dues.admin.status.webhookText: In the Stripe dashboard, add an endpoint at /api/plugins/dues/hook/stripe on this board’s public address, subscribed to exactly these events, and put its signing secret in the settings:
dues.gifts.heading: Gifts you bought
dues.go.heading: Over to Stripe…
dues.go.notAllowed: That is not somewhere this board sends people.
dues.go.paymentLead: Payment happens on Stripe’s own page — no card number ever touches this board. You should be there already;
dues.held.heading: What you hold
dues.manage.cancel-failed: That could not be cancelled. If it keeps failing, contact a moderator.
dues.manage.cancelled: Renewal cancelled. You keep everything you paid for until the period ends — nothing changes before then.
dues.manage.cardText: Cards, invoices and receipts live on Stripe, where the payment did. The portal is theirs; it comes back here when you are done.
dues.manage.grace: A renewal payment failed. Stripe retries on its own; updating your card below usually settles it.
dues.manage.no-customer: Stripe has no record for your account yet — the portal exists once you have bought something.
dues.manage.stripe-error: Stripe could not be reached. Try again shortly.
dues.manage.title: Your {label}
dues.manage.unconfigured: Payments are not fully set up on this board.
dues.notice.already-forever: You hold this membership for good already — there is nothing left to buy for it.
dues.notice.already-member: There is already an active subscription for that membership, so a second one would just charge twice for the same thing.
dues.notice.cancel-first: There is an active subscription for that membership. Cancel its renewal first, then buy the lifetime plan — you keep everything already paid for.
dues.notice.cancelled: Checkout was cancelled. Nothing was charged.
dues.notice.code-disabled: That discount code has been switched off.
dues.notice.code-exhausted: That discount code has been used as many times as it allows.
dues.notice.code-wrong-plan: That discount code is for a different plan.
dues.notice.gift-not-allowed: That plan cannot be bought for someone else. Fixed-term passes can.
dues.notice.plan-not-ready: That plan is not finished being set up — its Stripe price is missing. An administrator needs to complete it.
dues.notice.sign-in: Sign in first, so the membership has an account to attach to.
dues.notice.stripe-error: Stripe could not be reached, so nothing was charged. Try again shortly.
dues.notice.try-again: That did not go through cleanly. Nothing was charged — try once more.
dues.notice.unconfigured: Payments are not set up on this board yet. An administrator needs to finish the Stripe configuration before anything can be bought.
dues.notice.unknown-code: That discount code does not exist. Check the spelling.
dues.notice.unknown-plan: That plan is not on offer. The ones below are.
dues.notice.unknown-recipient: No member goes by that name. Check the spelling — the gift needs somewhere to go.
dues.plan.auto: Renews automatically. Cancel any time and keep what you paid for until the period ends.
dues.plan.discountCode: Discount code, if you have one.
dues.plan.empty: Nothing is on sale just now.
dues.plan.gift: Buying for another member? Their username — leave empty for yourself.
dues.plan.lifetime: One payment, no renewal, no end date.
dues.plan.payment: Payment is taken by Stripe on their own checkout page — no card number ever touches this board.
dues.return.confirmingText: Stripe is telling the board about your payment right now. This page does not grant anything by itself — the confirmation does, and it usually lands within seconds.
dues.return.giftPaid: Your gift of {plan} has been delivered. They hold it from this moment.
dues.return.noOrder: There is no order of yours here.
